name: God-Pharaoh
description: The ruler of Amonkhet whom Samut discovers to be the plane's destroyer.

description_citations.text: "Samut". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The benevolent God-Pharaoh is revealed to be Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: is actually Nicol Bolas, the malevolent dragon Planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond this plane.

citation.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut discovers the Trespasser glyph in the monument and realizes the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser and the destroyer of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.
